description: Ability pools by class. At each milestone level, players choose one ability from the available pool for that tier. They can also upgrade existing abilities instead of learning new ones.
upgrade_cost_description: Instead of learning a new ability, a player can upgrade an existing ability. Upgrades improve damage/healing multipliers by 20%, reduce cooldown by 1, or reduce MP cost by 15%.
